t: Self-regulating smart radiator valve that controls the flow of hot water into an individual radiator to manage heating room by room. Adjustable from a smartphone or tablet through the Hive app, whether using Hive Active heating or not. Works with any type of heating system, provided there are plumbed radiators with TRV bodies. Requires Hive Hub, Hive app and a compatible radiator valve.
b: Works with - Amazon Alexa - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
